title: Fixed completed-model residue comparison
statement: The first conjunct of lem-sfb-adic-immersion-residue-comparison: for every completed complex K, the normalized zeroth projection of sfbImmersionCompletedModel is isomorphic to derived sfbFixedResiduePull applied to sfbResidueComplex(K).

proof.text: Apply finiteComparison at exponent one to SfbCompletionNormalization.object X I K. Its source is definitionally the specified completed immersion model followed by normalized finite reduction.
Apply sfbResidue_normalization at X, then map the resulting isomorphism by the normalized derived pull functor. Its target is the exact derived transport T of the original fixed-scalar residue.

Factor T.mapDerivedCategory on the displayed residue complex. Since constantMap is an isomorphism, derivedPull_computes makes the derived pull comparison invertible on that transported complex. Apply mapHomologicalComplexCompIso to the ordinary constant residue square and localize. The inverse mapDerivedCategoryFactors for sfbFixedResiduePull identifies the final object with the original target.
